positions.title: Teacher Assistant for Algorithm Courses
positions.description:
• Organized computer science study sessions; tutored students on a variety of algorithmic topics.
• Coordinated with professors to facilitate learning, manage labs, and evaluate homework projects.

positions.title: Research Intern - Computational Cancer Biology Program
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented tools for dynamically inferring the evolutionary history of cancer cells from real, genetic sequencing data and simulated, synthetic data.
• Constructed algorithms and heuristics to evaluate and iteratively improve models for cancer histories.
• Expanded and applied statistical processes to measure program performance and effectiveness.
• Strategized with professors and graduate students to lead research, resulting in an accepted submission to the journal, Genome Biology, DOI: 10.1101/091595.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented back-end infrastructure for predicting the critical properties of detected security issues and for ranking them accordingly by their overall significance.
• Applied data analysis and machine learning techniques to utilize and evaluate models for ranking issues.
• Renovated front-end code to effectively utilize security issue rankings when displaying issues in user interfaces.
• Regularly presented and discussed with the team ideas and plans for progressing the internship project.

positions.title: Pre-Doctoral Student/Intern
positions.description:
• Developed methods to efficiently represent, analyze, and evaluate genetic/epigenetic data, and to compare different, potential approaches for visualizing the 3D nucleic structure of the cell.
• Utilized machine-learning paradigms to refine methods for processing multifaceted scientific data.
• Collaborated with Post-Doctoral mentors and other interns to develop applications for research findings.
